summary: Learn basic words with this educational game!
description: Baby Playground is an amazing educational game for babies 6 months and up to learn everyday vocabulary. The little ones will learn different elements such as animals, numbers or letters and will get to know the colors, geometric shapes and much more! Children can discover different elements in each of the 10 games that make up Baby Playground. Babies can interact with the elements of the game and enjoy fun animations just by tapping on the screen. EDUCATIONAL GAMES FOR EAR AND LANGUAGE STIMULATION Through this game, kids will be able to develop motor skills and stimulate language. Listening to different sounds and onomatopoeias will allow babies to establish associations between elements and strengthen their memory. 10 DIFFERENT THEMES: - Animals - Geometric forms - Transport - Musical instruments - Professions - Numbers from 0 to 9 - Alphabet letters - Fruits and food - Toys - Colors FEATURES - Game designed for babies and toddlers - Elements with fun animations - Kid-friendly graphics and sounds - Available in several languages - Completely free game ABOUT PLAYKIDS EDUJOY Thank you very much for playing Edujoy games. We love creating fun and educational games for children of all ages.
